data.narrative:
Airrow is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Menachem Fehler and David Kaye that has raised $350K to date. Valuation analysis relies on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—all operating in the same sector at Seed or Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $350K raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $875K. Peer-median analysis across five direct comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B), UFORCE ($1.0B), Castelion ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—produces a median valuation of $1.0B, though this range spans $125M to $4.0B, reflecting significant heterogeneity in the Defense & Security peer set at similar stages.

The triangulated range is $744K (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $500M. This wide dispersion reflects two distinct valuation signals: stage-progression anchored to minimal capital deployed, and peer-median driven by comparables substantially further along or capitalized at premium multiples. Key uncertainties include Airrow's differentiation within the crowded defense-tech space and whether peer valuations reflect revenue traction or investor momentum. Revenue data and customer pipeline would be necessary to narrow this range meaningfully.
